cameroon.name: Atlantic Beach Hotel
cameroon.description: Located near Down Beach in central Limbe, this hotel offers several room categories, an on-site restaurant and bar, a swimming pool, and conference facilities.

cameroon.name: Seme Beach Hotel
cameroon.description: A beachfront hotel in Bakingili near Limbe, with rooms, suites, apartments, tropical gardens, an oceanfront restaurant, spa facilities, and a private volcanic beach.

mauritius.name: Labourdonnais Waterfront Hotel
mauritius.description: A Port Louis hotel on the Caudan Waterfront, with rooms and suites, harbour views, restaurants, an outdoor pool, and a spa and fitness centre.

mauritius.name: Le Suffren Hotel & Marina
mauritius.description: A Port Louis hotel overlooking the Caudan Waterfront marina, with nautical-themed rooms, restaurants, a swimming pool, and a wellness club near the city centre.

tanzania.name: Zanzibar Serena Hotel
tanzania.description: A seafront hotel in Stone Town, Zanzibar, occupying restored historic buildings and offering rooms with Swahili design details, ocean views, and on-site dining.

tanzania.name: Park Hyatt Zanzibar
tanzania.description: A beachfront hotel on Shangani Street in Stone Town, Zanzibar, with rooms and suites, an ocean-facing pool, spa facilities, and waterfront dining.

ghana.name: Kempinski Hotel Gold Coast City Accra
ghana.description: Located in central Accra's business district, this hotel offers rooms and suites, multiple dining venues, a swimming pool, and the on-site Resense Spa.

ghana.name: Mövenpick Ambassador Hotel Accra
ghana.description: On Independence Avenue in Accra's Ridge district, this hotel offers rooms and suites with garden or city views, restaurants, and a lagoon-style swimming pool.

kenya.name: Nairobi Serena Hotel
kenya.description: Beside Central Park in Nairobi, this hotel has gardens, rooms and suites, restaurants, a heated swimming pool, and the Maisha Spa and Health Club.

kenya.name: Sarova Stanley
kenya.description: A historic hotel at Kenyatta Avenue and Kimathi Street in central Nairobi, offering guestrooms and suites, several dining venues, a rooftop pool, and health club.

south-africa.name: Victoria & Alfred Hotel
south-africa.description: A hotel at Cape Town's V&A Waterfront, offering rooms in a historic setting with views of the harbour and Table Mountain from the property.

south-africa.name: Cape Grace, A Fairmont Managed Hotel
south-africa.description: Set on a private quay in Cape Town's V&A Waterfront, this hotel has harbour-facing accommodation, restaurants, a swimming pool, and spa facilities.

japan.name: Imperial Hotel, Tokyo
japan.description: A Tokyo hotel in Hibiya, near the Imperial Palace and Ginza, offering guestrooms, suites, restaurants, shops, and indoor fitness and swimming facilities.

japan.name: Keio Plaza Hotel Tokyo
japan.description: Located in Tokyo's Nishi-Shinjuku district, this high-rise hotel offers rooms and suites, multiple restaurants, and upper-floor lounges overlooking the surrounding city skyline.

thailand.name: Chatrium Bangkok Riverside
thailand.description: A Bangkok hotel beside the Chao Phraya River, with rooms and suites, river views, dining venues, and an outdoor swimming pool overlooking the river.

thailand.name: Riva Surya Bangkok
thailand.description: On Phra Athit Road in Bangkok, this riverside hotel offers rooms with balconies, a swimming pool, dining, and access to Chao Phraya riverboat services.

vietnam.name: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi
vietnam.description: A historic hotel on Ngo Quyen Street in Hanoi's Hoan Kiem district, with rooms across two wings, several restaurants, a courtyard, and outdoor pool.

vietnam.name: La Siesta Premium Hang Be
vietnam.description: On Hang Be Street in Hanoi's Old Quarter, this hotel offers rooms and suites, a restaurant, a rooftop bar, and an on-site spa.

india.name: The Imperial New Delhi
india.description: A heritage hotel on Janpath in New Delhi, with rooms and suites, art collections, several restaurants, gardens, and a dedicated spa and wellness offering.

india.name: The Claridges New Delhi
india.description: Located in New Delhi's Lutyens district, this hotel dates to 1955 and offers rooms and suites, several restaurants, gardens, and a fitness club.

indonesia.name: Meliá Purosani Yogyakarta
indonesia.description: In central Yogyakarta near Malioboro, this hotel offers rooms and suites, tropical gardens, a lagoon-style pool, several dining venues, and an on-site spa.

indonesia.name: The Phoenix Hotel Yogyakarta - Handwritten Collection
indonesia.description: A heritage hotel on Jalan Jenderal Sudirman in central Yogyakarta, combining European, Chinese, and Javanese design influences with guestrooms, dining, and a swimming pool.

france.name: Hôtel Le Six
france.description: A Paris hotel on Rue Stanislas in the Luxembourg–Montparnasse area, with rooms and suites, a hammam, massage rooms, and access to nearby metro stations.

france.name: Hôtel L de Lutèce
france.description: A boutique hotel on Île Saint-Louis in Paris, occupying a building with seventeenth-century origins near the Seine, with rooms, a suite, and a wellness studio.

italy.name: Hotel Artemide
italy.description: Located on Via Nazionale in central Rome, this hotel offers rooms and suites, the Ambrosia rooftop restaurant, and a spa near the Repubblica and Termini areas.

italy.name: iQ Hotel Roma
italy.description: A Rome hotel overlooking Piazza del Teatro dell’Opera, with rooms, a rooftop restaurant and bar, a gym, and a sauna in the city’s central district.

spain.name: Hotel Jazz
spain.description: Located on Carrer de Pelai in central Barcelona, Hotel Jazz has a rooftop pool and terrace between Plaça Catalunya, Passeig de Gràcia, and La Rambla.

spain.name: Hotel 1898
spain.description: A Barcelona hotel at 109 La Rambla, with rooms and suites, a rooftop terrace, and a spa featuring a thermal circuit and an indoor pool.

portugal.name: Heritage Lisboa Plaza Hotel
portugal.description: A family-owned Lisbon hotel just off Avenida da Liberdade, open since 1954 and part of Lisbon Heritage Hotels, with rooms in the historic city centre.

portugal.name: Hotel Britania Art Deco
portugal.description: An Art Deco hotel in Lisbon near Avenida da Liberdade, with 35 rooms, restored period furnishings, a lounge, and a bar in a historic building.

greece.name: Electra Palace Athens
greece.description: Located in the Plaka district of Athens, this hotel offers rooms and suites, indoor and seasonal outdoor pools, and a rooftop restaurant overlooking the Acropolis.

greece.name: Herodion Hotel
greece.description: An Athens hotel near the Acropolis Museum, with 90 guest rooms, restaurants, a bar, and a roof garden featuring views toward the Acropolis archaeological site.

united-states.name: Library Hotel
united-states.description: A literature-themed hotel on Madison Avenue at East 41st Street in New York City, with guest rooms, a reading room, and a rooftop lounge.

united-states.name: citizenM New York Bowery
united-states.description: A New York City hotel in the Bowery area, with tablet-controlled rooms, a rooftop bar, a gym, and street art displayed along its stairwell.

canada.name: Fairmont Le Château Frontenac
canada.description: A historic château hotel inside the walls of Old Québec in Québec City, with rooms and suites, several dining venues, and a spa on site.

canada.name: Hôtel Clarendon
canada.description: A historic hotel in Old Québec, Québec City, welcoming guests since 1870 and offering rooms within the fortified district near the city’s principal heritage attractions.

mexico.name: Zócalo Central

mexico.name: Histórico Central
mexico.description: A hotel in Mexico City’s historic centre, set in a colonial building near Torre Latinoamericana and the Palace of Fine Arts, with rooms and suites.

costa-rica.name: Hotel Presidente

costa-rica.name: Gran Hotel Costa Rica, Curio Collection by Hilton
costa-rica.description: A San José hotel in a building dating to 1930, on Avenida Central near the National Theatre and Gold Museum, with dining and a piano bar.

jamaica.name: The Courtleigh Hotel & Suites
jamaica.description: A hotel in New Kingston, Kingston, with guest rooms, one-bedroom and penthouse suites, and Alexander’s restaurant, close to the district’s business offices and cultural landmarks.

jamaica.name: The Jamaica Pegasus Hotel

brazil.name: Copacabana Palace, A Belmond Hotel

brazil.name: Hotel Fasano Rio de Janeiro

peru.name: Hotel B

peru.name: JW Marriott Hotel Lima

argentina.name: Alvear Palace Hotel

argentina.name: Palo Santo Hotel

chile.name: Hotel Magnolia

chile.name: The Singular Santiago

colombia.name: Sofitel Legend Santa Clara Cartagena

colombia.name: Charleston Santa Teresa Hotel

australia.name: The Grace Hotel

australia.name: Four Seasons Hotel Sydney

new-zealand.name: Bolton Hotel

new-zealand.name: InterContinental Wellington

fiji.name: Grand Pacific Hotel

samoa.name: Tanoa Tusitala Hotel

vanuatu.name: Warwick Le Lagon - Vanuatu

vanuatu.name: Nasama Resort

antarctica.name: Quark Expeditions

antarctica.name: National Geographic-Lindblad Expeditions
